title: Pan-Seared Russian Dumplings
description: A hearty Russian dish, these pan-seared dumplings are filled with a savory umami flavor and served with a side of flaky stir-fried vegetables.
instructions: Combine flour, water, umami-flavored broth, milk, and eggs in a bowl to form the dumpling dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each disk and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add 1/4 cup of vegetable oil.
Add the onion and stir-fry vegetables to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with the stir-fry vegetables on the side.
